baseline.formula: previous_return = prior close / prior-prior close - 1; momentum = mean(last 3 daily returns); volatility = population standard deviation(last 4 daily returns); expected_return = clamp(round(0.60 × momentum - 0.10 × volatility, 2), -5, +5); expected_open = round(prior_close × (1 + expected_return / 100), 2); actual_return = actual_open / prior_close - 1; error = actual_return - expected_return.
baseline.note: This is a reproducible public-daily baseline generated after the fact because no historical 08:20 pre-open quote/order-book snapshot is available. It uses only the five prior trading-session daily closes, is not the historical 08:20 forecast, and must not be described as one.

meta.actual_field_note: actual_open/actual_close/actual_volume are observed source values; actual_return is 09:00 actual_open versus prior close; expected_open/expected_return are retrospective public-daily momentum/volatility baseline values; expected_close is null because this test targets the open.
meta.source_range: mrktCtg=KOSPI; every published KOSPI row in the source daily CSV; no empty actual_open/actual_close/actual_volume rows; source does not expose a security-type field and contains no ETF rows.

evaluation.note: Historical-test only. This staged evaluation is isolated from operating snapshots and does not represent live forecast performance.
